interpretation: Descriptive per-run and median observations only; unknown evidence remains null and no significance or universal claim is computed.

review_queue.command: git diff check.php .php-ast-edit.json composer.json config/services.yaml autoload.php
php -l src/Contract.php src/Base.php src/Child.php src/Consumer.php src/Other.php src/OtherConsumer.php && echo "✓ All PHP files have valid syntax"

# Check that preserved files match their original content
cd /tmp/php-ast-v080-haiku-clarified-20260911/runs/run005/work

# Verify check.php
if [ "$(md5sum check.php | awk '{print $1}')" != "" ]; then
  echo "check.php exists and is readable"
fi

# Verify composer.json
if grep -q '"autoload":{"psr-4"' composer.json; then
  echo "composer.json is intact"
fi

# Verify .php-ast-edit.json
if grep -q '"verify"' .php-ast-edit.json; then
  echo ".php-ast-edit.json is intact"
fi

# Verify config/services.yaml
if grep -q '^label: fetch$' config/services.yaml; then
  echo "config/services.yaml is intact"
fi

cd /tmp/php-ast-v080-haiku-clarified-20260911/runs/run005/work

# Check Other.php still has fetch()
if grep -q 'public function fetch(): int' src/Other.php; then
  echo "✓ Other::fetch() preserved"
fi

# Check OtherConsumer.php still calls fetch()
if grep -q '\$service->fetch()' src/OtherConsumer.php; then
  echo "✓ OtherConsumer fetch() call preserved"
fi

# Check Consumer now calls load()
if grep -q '\$service->load()' src/Consumer.php; then
  echo "✓ Consumer now calls load()"
fi

# Verify all modified files have load()
for file in src/Contract.php src/Base.php src/Child.php; do
  if grep -q 'public function load(): int' "$file"; then
    echo "✓ $(basename $file) has load() method"
  fi
done
php-ast-edit apply --file src/Contract.php --select method:Contract::fetch --op rename_method --to load
